'''Jakris''' was a [[Mon Calamari]]<ref name="Ahsoka One" /> [[New Republic Security Guard|guard]]<ref name="Part One AD">{{Ahsoka|Part One: Master and Apprentice}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> who served as a top [[security officer]]<ref name="Databank-Hayle">{{Databank|captain-hayle|Captain Hayle}}</ref> aboard the [[New Republic Defense Fleet]]<ref name="Ahsoka One" /> [[Defender-class cruiser|''Defender''-class cruiser]]<ref name="Comprehensive">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> ''[[Vesper]]''<ref name="Princess Vesper">{{SW|url=news/ahsoka-part-1-master-and-apprentice-highlights|text=''Ahsoka'' Analyzed: 5 Highlights from "Part One: Master and Apprentice"}}</ref> in [[Sector G-38]].<ref name="Ahsoka One" /> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Baylan Skoll|two]] [[Shin Hati|individuals]] claiming to be [[Jedi]] boarded the [[cruiser]], intending to see a [[Morgan Elsbeth|prisoner]] being held onboard. The [[Starship|ship's]] [[captain]], [[Hayle]], greeted them and brought six security members, including Jakris, along with him. Hayle welcomed the pair but then accused them of being impostors<ref name="Ahsoka One" />—he<ref name="Part One AD" /> instructed Jakris to have the [[astromech droid]] [[RD-3]] scan them for identification. Before Jakris could, one of the visitors ignited<ref name="Ahsoka One" /> her<ref name="Part One AD" /> [[Shin Hati's lightsaber|lightsaber]] and [[Attack on the Vesper|slashed]] the Mon Calamari's midsection,<ref name="Ahsoka One" /> [[Death|killing]] them.<ref name="Ships 99">{{ShipsandVehiclesCite|99|History of the Ship}}</ref>

Jakris had [[Color|red]] skin and green [[eye]]s. The Mon Calamari wore the blue [[New Republic soldier's uniform|uniform]] and [[helmet]] of a [[New Republic]] [[security guard]], [[holster]]ing an [[A-180 blaster]] within a [[utility belt]]. Jakris's [[Clothing|uniform]] had a patch depicting an astromech [[droid]] on its right shoulder.<ref name="Ahsoka One" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jakris first appeared in "[[Part One: Master and Apprentice]]," the first episode of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'',<ref name="Ahsoka One" /> which aired on [[August 22]], [[2023]].<ref name="Release">{{SW|url=news/ahsoka-new-premiere-date|text=''Ahsoka'' Premiere Moves Up to Tuesday, August 22}}</ref>
